features.latin: complete consecutive Unicode Latin letters, lowercased; internal ASCII or curly apostrophe retained and normalized to ASCII
features.number: ASCII decimal digit run, optional decimal point between digits; optional leading ASCII +/- only after a non-alphanumeric boundary; exact spelling retained
features.han: bigrams within a consecutive Unicode Han run; a one-character Han run retains one singleton feature
features.boundaries: whitespace, punctuation and script/type boundaries never join words or Han runs; internal apostrophe and decimal/sign syntax are the declared exceptions
features.deduplication: set per query and document; repeated features do not increase score
features.unsupported: no stemming, synonyms, translation, Unicode compatibility folding, spelled-number conversion or unit conversion

negation_and_numbers: not, no, never, neither, nor, without, cannot and contractions are retained; numeric literals are never function-word filtered

ranking.score: sum IDF for unique exact query/document feature intersections
ranking.N: number of source-valid, scope-eligible documents in this case, including documents without matching features
ranking.df: number of eligible documents containing the feature, counted once per document
ranking.tie_break: stable supplied document id ascending; probe uses fixture id, independent of relevance labels
ranking.candidate_gate: at least one feature intersection; no tuned score/confidence threshold

conditions.goal: 弄明白停止距离和车速的关系
conditions.context_reference: context.rs build_context query construction with a nonempty session.state.goal; no empty-goal continuation fallback in this condition

baseline: real Store::recall on an isolated simulator for both conditions, plus unchanged lexical results from e5-education-first for current_query
evaluation_limits: v2 is a previously observed diagnostic set, never a new holdout
Report all 25 queries under both conditions, including worse rows and multi-evidence coverage
Query-plus-goal uses the original question's relevance labels; it diagnoses goal-driven candidate inclusion, not whether historical activity context is useful
No feature overlap is a lexical outcome, not a calibrated model abstention or proof that no relevant evidence exists
Sources and kind remain typed provenance, never similarity-derived truth or completion claims
The temporary drawing request stays the original diagnostic topical report, not a persistent preference
Independent future test texts must be authored only after this method is frozen; do not tune on v2 and relabel it as held out
